synopsis: VTDx is the cloud-oriented variant of Virtual Test Drive (VTD), and both are commercial platforms whose ownership moved from Hexagon to Cadence in February 2026 [f8427, f8983, f15891]. The booklet lists them among complete or near-complete simulation platforms, but the evidence provided is on-road only; vendor-cloud off-road relevance follows the underlying platform, leaving off-road applicability unestablished here [f8347, f8984, f9255]. Listed capabilities include camera, lidar and radar sensors, OpenSCENARIO and OpenDRIVE, and SIL/HIL/DIL interfaces or modes [f8985, f8986]. Release information includes version 2026.1 dated 10 April 2026 and a listing for 2026.2 [f8988]. Public prices were not found for VTD/VTDx or the listed vendor-cloud alternatives; the cloud pricing table cites sources dated 2024–2026 [f8987, f9256, f16060].
